description:
verify.rs:191-192 and :284-285 both document the window as `[log.usable_from_ms, log.retired_at_ms]` (square brackets on both sides). The actual implementation in `log_window_contains` (verify.rs:845-857) uses `timestamp_ms < lo` (inclusive lower) and `timestamp_ms >= hi` (exclusive upper), making the real window `[lo, hi)` — half-open.

What would make it clear: update both rustdoc bullet points to `[log.usable_from_ms, log.retired_at_ms)` and the `log_window_contains` doc comment (already correct at line 841) is the canonical statement. Or, less preferably, change the implementation to match the docs.

Audience: someone reading rustdoc to decide whether an SCT timestamped exactly at `retired_at_ms` is supposed to verify. Today, the docs say yes; the code says no. Programmers reading the source will be told contradictory things.
title: doc comments on verify_sct_for_cert/verify_sct_for_precert say [lo, hi] but log_window_contains is [lo, hi)
